properties.kvalitet: The age and structure of the forest is of great interest, the red-listed species (present knowledge) are restricted to the beech. Contains three habitats of priority: 7110, 91D0 and 9010.
properties.karaktar: An old natural forest, typical for southwest Sweden. The beech forest has long continuity while the coniferous is mostly secondary forest.

properties.kvalitet: The salt marshes/pastures and extensive areas of shallow water are of great value for marine biology, geology, fishery-biology, ornithology and botany. The salt pastures are in a good state.
properties.karaktar: A great estuary with vast and undisturbed shallow water areas, completed with an archipelago of heathlands and an eastern coast with salt marshes and pastures. Oak-forests of biological interest.
properties.arter: Blå kärrhök, Brun kärrhök, Brushane, Fiskgjuse, Fisktärna, Grön sköldmossa, Grönbena, Kentsk tärna, Knubbsäl, Lax (i sötvatten), Ljungpipare, Myrspov, Salskrake, Sydlig kärrsnäppa, Sångsvan

properties.kvalitet: The site is one of very few meadows on wet ground in the region where grass cutting still is managed in a traditional way. Rich flora with orchids and dense stands of Trollius europaeus.
properties.karaktar: Ekered is a fen with a rich flora including orchids and dense stands of Trollius europaeus. The fen is partially managed by annual hay cutting.

properties.kvalitet: Fegen is a unique, great oligotrophic lake with a rich fauna containing the endemic and strongly endangered fish Coregonus trybomi. The area contains two habitat types of priority: 7110, 91D0.
properties.karaktar: A great oligotrophic lake with a rich bird- and fishlife.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient beech forest with a rich fauna and flora. Several red-listed species.
properties.karaktar: Ancient beech forest, which is a remnant of an extensive area of beech forest from the 17th to the 19th centuries.

properties.kvalitet: A complex of undisturbed mires and natural forests. The area contains a high biodiversity and two habitats of priority: 7110 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: A forest - mire complex with undisturbed mires and natural forests. High biodiversity.
properties.arter: Ljungpipare, Orre, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Tjäder

properties.kvalitet: The well-grazed pastures and marshes have a valuable breeding and migratory birdlife, and a very interesting vegetation adapted to high salinity.
properties.karaktar: A rocky peninsula covered with heathland, separated from the mainland by vast salt marshes.

properties.kvalitet: Large area of decideous wood with a big mixture of trees and containing several rare and even threatened species, mainly lichens och fungi, but also plants, birds and invertebrates.
properties.karaktar: Steep south-fencing slope consisting mostly of broad-leaved woodland next to a big lake. Parts of the woods are undisturbed och contains several rare species of birds, fungi, lichens and plants. The dominating trees are lime (Tilia), oak (Quercus), beech (Fagus) and elm (Ulmus).

properties.kvalitet: Island with large colonies of birds, especially gulls and eider.
properties.karaktar: Tylön is a small island near the coast, with a very rich birdlife.

properties.kvalitet: A representative part of the old coastal heath-landscape, which still is managed in a traditional way by grazing. The site contains one habitat of priority:  6230.
properties.karaktar: A coastal heath and grassland landscape.

properties.kvalitet: Down to 4-5 m depth Isoetes sp covers the bottom. The blue-green algae Nostoc zetterstedtii occurred in the SE part of the lake, but has not been recorded since 1986.
properties.karaktar: Eka sjö has no visible in- or outlets and water supply is based on ground water. The lake is deep (max depth 25-30 m) and very clear (water colour 5 mg PtL -1, secchi depth approx. 10 m).

properties.kvalitet: The epiphytic lichen and moss flora on the old beech stems is rich and several of the species are red listed.
properties.karaktar: Beech forests on slopes. The trees are of different ages and there are dead fallen trees and high stumps.

properties.kvalitet: River with a genuine stock of wild salmon.
properties.karaktar: River Rolfsån flows through farmlands. Areas with rapids and fast flowing waters.

properties.kvalitet: The area is a well preserved and species rich meadow that still is used for hay harvesting. This kind of habitats are uncommon and of high values.
properties.karaktar: The site is situated near by a farm in a slightly undulating agricultural landscape.

properties.kvalitet: One of the biggest lakes in south-west Sweden. The water is oligotrophic and the fish Coregonus trybomi is living here as one of the few places in the entire world.
properties.karaktar: Coregonus trybomi. Beautiful landscape.
properties.arter: Barbastell, Fiskgjuse, Fisktärna, Gråhäger, Smålom, Storlom

properties.kvalitet: Very rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, many of them redlisted, on beech stems. Also several interesting birds and presumably also beetles connected to old beeches.
properties.karaktar: Beech forests of different ages growing on siliceous rocky slopes. Old beeches dominate the forest, both thick wellgrown as well as thin late-grown stems. Rich occurrence of dead wood.

properties.kvalitet: The site is well preserved and species rich with some rare plants. The area has a long continuity as a meadow.
properties.karaktar: This site is situated at a high level around the two farms at Nockakulla and consists of two areas. The surroundings consists of agricultural landscape close to the farms and coniferous woods further away.

properties.kvalitet: Ett ovanligt mångformigt och tämligen orört myrkomplex med högt ornitologiska värden, respresentativt för västra Sverige.
properties.karaktar: En stor och mångformig mosse med välutvecklade och representativa myrtyper. Svagt välvda , exentriska sluttande och högmossar samt kärr, sjö och åmader.

properties.kvalitet: During the agricultural expansion of the 18th and 19th centuries great parts of this site became an almost treeless land with heaths formed by grazing. Since grazing in the outlying lands were abandoned a partly spontaneous reforestation of the landscape has taken place. In some places there are projects going on with the aim to restore the pastoral landscape. The site contains deciduous and coniferous forests, heaths and mires that have a rich birdlife with several species included in the National Red List.
properties.karaktar: Large nature tract where the higher, rocky areas are covered with forests and heaths. In several places there are valleys with mires, lakes or agricultural land.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Nattskärra, Orre, Skogsduva, Spillkråka, Sångsvan, Trädlärka

properties.kvalitet: Deciduous forests with untouched character and a rich fauna and flora with several nationally red-listed species.  The area contains two habitats of priority: 9080 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Rift valley covered by deciduous forests of untouched character. The site also contains a swamp-forest of alder and birch.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, many of them redlisted. Also some interesting birds. The beech forests are part of an area along the river Ätran with old beech forests constituting high conservancy values.
properties.karaktar: Beech forests of different ages growing on slopes in close connection to the river Ätran. Old and rather wellgrown beeches dominates in the northern part, whereas late-grown and thinner trees are more common in the southern parts. In the southern part the ages are more varied and the forest structure more developed.

properties.kvalitet: A representative outfield with absolute unique and diverse flora including redlisted species. One of the most valuable grazed pastures of Halland. Contains two habitats of priority; 6230 and 6270.
properties.karaktar: The site is an open wellgrazed outfield surrounded by intensive farming. It contains a mosaic of dry to wet areas. The flora of vascular plants is very rich.

properties.kvalitet: A representative area of shallow banks in middle of Kattegat. A diverse flora of makroalgae.
properties.karaktar: Shallow bank with stones, gravel, sand and finer fractions surrounding a reef consisting of boulderstones. The flora algae are diverse. Especially important are the kelp beds.

properties.kvalitet: Hallands Väderö är Skånes utpost i Kattegatt och ett på många sätt unikt område med en hög mångformighet i landskapet ¿ både under och över vattenytan. Det mosaikartade landskapet, där landmiljöerna på själva Hallands Väderö är präglade av långvarig hävd, har lett till en mängd olika naturtyper och livsmiljöer som möjliggör en stor biologisk mångfald och artdiversitet med många hotade och sällsynta arter. Öns skogsområden och naturbetesmarker är av stor ekologisk betydelse nationellt såväl som internationellt genom stor areal äldre ädellövskog med högt innehåll av död ved samt genom förekomsten av öppna och trädbärande naturbetesmarker. Det högproduktiva havsområdet med holmar och skär och med en rik marin flora och fauna ger förutsättningar för områdets höga värde för fisk, marina däggdjur och fågel. Exploateringsgraden är låg vilket lett till en fristad för en mängd olika arter, varav många är hotade. Landskapet är av stort kulturhistoriskt värde samtidigt som det är vackert och intressant att vandra genom vilket lockar många besökare.
properties.karaktar:
Ö, Naturen på Hallands Väderö är mycket omväxlande med ängar, skogar, kärr, enbuskmarker och ljunghedar. 
Karaktäristiskt för Hallands Väderö är busksnåren. Särskilt i skogsbrynen på den västra sidan är dessa starkt påverkade av vinden.
Ön, med dess kringliggande holmar och skär är av stor vikt för områdets sälstam och fågelfauna.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Blå kärrhök, Brun kärrhök, Brushane, Fiskgjuse, Fisktärna, Grönbena, Kentsk tärna, Knubbsäl, Ljungpipare, Läderbagge, Mindre flugsnappare, Myrspov, Silvertärna, Småtärna, Stenfalk, Sångsvan, Törnskata, Vitkindad gås

properties.kvalitet: A representative, open coast area. The site contains 10 habitat types of which one is of priority:  6230.
properties.karaktar: A coastal area dominated by sea cliffs and open heathlands.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains 11 habitat types, of which four are of priority: 6270, 6230, 7110 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Part of the old agricultural landscape with a "cluster of farms"; meadows, grazing pastures and oak forests. Contains hay meadows, pollards and other ancient cultural elements.

properties.kvalitet: A unique heath-mire area which has a long continuity as a grazed and regularly burned area. The fauna and flora is rich with several red-listed species. The site contains one habitat of priority; 6230.
properties.karaktar: A grazed and burned heath on moraine with mires in the lower parts.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, many of them redlisted.
properties.karaktar: Old beech forests on moraine ground, partly surrounded by mires.

properties.kvalitet: Island with a grazed landscape representative for the marine coast area. Rich fauna and flora. The site contains 12 habitat types, of which one is of priority: 6230.
properties.karaktar: Open grazed island with sandy areas, heathland and salt marshes.
properties.arter: Fisktärna, Gråsäl, Knubbsäl, Skärfläcka, Småtärna, Tumlare, Törnskata

properties.kvalitet: Område med en diverse bottenfauna, bl a koralldjur, och som utgör ett viktigt lekområde för torsk. Det förekommer ett betydande antal av rastande/övervintrande änder och området är särskilt viktigt för sjöorre och svärta (viktigast lokalen i landet för dessa båda arter). Tumlare förekommer under hela året och i högst antal under det varmare halvåret. Par med mor och kalv ses vanligen och även grupper med tumlare. Knubbsäl är vanligt förekommande, men det finns även gråsäl.
properties.karaktar: Området sträcker sig från helt kustnära ut till ekonomisk zon. Djupintervallet varierar mellan dryga 3 m till 46 m. Dominerande djupintervall är 20-30 m. I Öresundsdelen blandas vattenmassor med olika salthalt. Mjukbottnar dominerar (mest lera, men även sand) men det finns även inslag av hårdbottnar runt Kullen. Stor variation i biotoper, evertebrat- och fiskfauna. Övervintringsområde för sjöfågel. Hög förekomst av tumlare under hela året, särskilt varmare halvåret. Kalvar vanligt förekommande.
properties.arter: Alfågel, Bergand, Bläsand, Dvärgmås, Ejder, Fiskgjuse, Fiskmås, Fisktärna, Gravand, Gräsand, Gråhakedopping, Gråsäl, Gråtrut, Havstrut, Kentsk tärna, Knipa, Knubbsäl, Knölsvan, Kustlabb, Mellanskarv, Prutgås, Sillgrissla, Silltrut, Silvertärna, Sjöorre, Skrattmås, Skräntärna, Skäggdopping, Smålom, Småskrake, Småtärna, Storlom, Storskarv, Storskrake, Svarthakedopping, Svarttärna, Svärta, Sångsvan, Tobisgrissla, Toppskarv, Tordmule, Tumlare, Vigg

properties.kvalitet: A representative pasture managed by grazing. Constitute one of a few localities in forest region for Maculinea alcon. Contain two habitats of priority: 6230 and 6270.
properties.karaktar: The site is an open pasture with a rich flora, some redlisted.

properties.kvalitet: Fennoscandian hemiboreal natural old broadleaved decidius Fagus sylvatica forest. The area has a lot of rare and red listed species of lichens, fungus and mosses. For example is the redlisted Neckera pumila found here. The site has a lot of dying and dead trees.
properties.karaktar: The site is a part of a bigger area with Fagus sylvatica.

properties.kvalitet: A representative coastal area with various habitats and a rich fauna and flora. The area is managed in a traditional way with grazing and burning. The site contains 14 habitats, of which two are of priority: 2130 and 6230.
properties.karaktar: A coastal heath landscape managed by grazing and burning.

properties.kvalitet: A varied and representative coastal area with rich fauna and flora. The site contains 15 habitat types, of which three are of priority: 2130, 2140 and 6230.
properties.karaktar: Coastal area with grazed open heathland, sand dunes, sea cliffs and grassland.

properties.kvalitet: Western taiga, bog woodland and small mires in a mosaic.
properties.karaktar: Western taiga and bog woodland.

properties.kvalitet: A vast and various area with different kinds of undisturbed bogs, mires, lakes and natural forests.
properties.karaktar: A  vast and  various area with different kinds of undisturbed bogs, mires, lakes and natural forests.
properties.arter: Fiskgjuse, Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Nattskärra, Orre, Pärluggla, Spillkråka, Storlom, Tjäder, Trana

properties.kvalitet: Rich fauna and flora with several redlisted species. The area contains two habitats of priority: 6270 and 6230.
properties.karaktar: An open coastal heath and grass landscape managed by regular burning in spring. Military exercise area.

properties.kvalitet: A great many of redlisted species have been noted from different kinds of organisms, mostly lichens, fungi, mosses and birds. The invertebrate fauna is probably very valuable. In addition, the rich variety of habitats and well developed forest structure make this area very special for the region.                             The site contains three habitats of priority: 9020, 9080 and 91E0
properties.karaktar: Deciduous forests on both sides of the river Nissan along a distance of 1500m. Low degree of human forestry impact. Rich variety of forest types; old broad-leaved deciduous forests rich in epiphytes, deciduous swamp woods, beech forests of different age and edaphic conditions and alluvial forests. Furthermore ironrich springs, siliceous rocky slopes and varied stream conditions can be encountered.

properties.kvalitet: One of few ancient forests on the Swedish west coast. The forest has high biological values with numerous nationally red-listed species of invertebrates, cryptogams and birds. The site contains two habitats of priority: 9180 and 91E0.
properties.karaktar: Ancient forest of pine and oak at the sea-border.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient woodland with one of the greatest concentrations of old oak trees in the region. Rich epiphyte flora with several nationally red-listed species. The site contains two habitats of priority: 91D0 and 9080.
properties.karaktar: The site is part of a larger area with oak and beech forests and contains ancient forests with high biodiversity.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient forest with a rich ephiphytic flora; several nationally red-listed species.
properties.karaktar: A rocky area with ancient beech forests.

properties.kvalitet: One of the richest fen of the region which has been managed continuausly since the 1980th, after a period of extensive grazing and overgrowth. The site contains an habitat of priority.
properties.karaktar: The area consists of an alder swamp wood and a managed fen, both very rich in flora and fauna.

properties.kvalitet: Herb rich old broad-leaved deciduous forest in a beautiful situation along the old river. Buxbaumia viridis has been seen around 1975 on a middle-aged log of spruce. The site contains two habitats of priority: 9080 and 9070.
properties.karaktar: Deciduous forest along the old river Lagan. Oak forest, swamp forest and mixed forest with pine. Also grazed wooded pastures with old trees of linden, ash, maple, oak etc.

properties.kvalitet: One of the region´s few unexploited beech woodlands. Includes a number of threatened species.
properties.karaktar: The site is totally dominated by beech woodland and is fringed by other kinds of deciduous woodlands.

properties.kvalitet: The larger mirecomplex including Kloö is practically untouched with well developed structures.
properties.karaktar: The area is in the centre of a larger mire complex and consists of a smaller part with open fens and nature forest. There is also a remainder from a crofter´s holding.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient forest with several nationally red-listed species and two habitats of priority: 9080 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Ancient forest situated in a slope towards east with great moraine blocks and spring floods.

properties.kvalitet: The epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses is rich on the old beeches, some of the species are redlisted.
properties.karaktar: Beech forests of different ages on hills and slopes. Many beeches are old and there are dead fallen trees and high stumps.

properties.kvalitet: A rich flora and fauna is connected to the deciduous forests, including nationally red-listed epiphytes. The site contains two habitat types of priority: 9080, 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Old beech forests with elements of oak and deciduous swamp woods with alder.

properties.kvalitet: Traditionally managed agricultural landscape with hay meadows and ancient crops. The area has high biodiversity and contains four habitats of priority: 6230, 7110, 9080 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Old agricultural landscape with grazed meadows, hay meadows, mires and natural forests.

properties.kvalitet: A representative heath area with a unique flora and nationally red-listed species including Genista anglica. Managed by grazing. Contains two habitats of priority: 6270 and 6230.
properties.karaktar: A grazed and burned heath with red-listed species.

properties.kvalitet: The wood has been left for free development and in the mixed wood there are found some old many stemmed, "sprawling beeches". In the area are also some dead wood in the form of high-stumps and lying wood.
properties.karaktar: In this area Århultsbäcken is floating into a deep ravine. The north slope is mostly covered with Luzulo-Fagetum beech forest with some elements of alder-covered soaks. The area contains a highly developed epiphytic flora, mainly lichens.

properties.kvalitet: An area with alluvial broad-leaved forests along the submountainous river Fylleån. The site has a very high biodiversity and contains one habitat of priority: 91E0.
properties.karaktar: An area with alluvial broad-leaved forests along the submountainous river Fylleån.

properties.kvalitet: Naturlig fodermark med lång hävdkontinuitet. På grund av vegetationssammansättningen, närvaro av kalk i jorden, översilande vatten och en lång slåttertradition finns en rik kärlväxtflora. Ängen har ett stort värde för djurlivet, som bland annat består av flera sällsynta landmollusker.
properties.karaktar: En kalkrik, naturligt översilad sidvallsäng av gräs- och lågstarrtyp. Runt ängen finns översilad alskog. Ängen har restaurerats och hävdas årligen sedan 1989 med slåtter.

properties.kvalitet: One of very few remaining common grazing lands in the region. Open grassland with small numbers of junipers, elder bushes and hawthorn dispersed over the site. The flora is dominated by drought-resistant plants such as Carex arenaria, Sedum acre and Armeria maritima. Close to the small stream moist meadows are dominating. The grasslands have never been exposed to nitrogen fertilizers.
properties.karaktar: Traditional grazing land on an area of shifting sands just by the coast of Skälderviken. A small stream through the area runs dry during hot summers. Most of the coastal areas int this part of the County have been exploited for recreational purposes. Stora Hulst fälad is one of very few exceptions, surrounded by holidays resorts as it is.

properties.kvalitet: Natural forests with several species of nationally red-listed mosses and lichens including Bryhnia novae-angliae. The site contains and one habitat of priority: 9080.
properties.karaktar: A woodland area with natural forests of various character; beech forests, swamp forests with birch, alder and spruce and mixed forests with beech, oak and spruce.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, rich ground flora of herbs and mosses, redlisted species. Several interesting birds. The site contains two habitats of priority: 9080 and 9020.
properties.karaktar: Old, semi-rich beech forest in untouched state and structure. Near the village also broad-leaved forest with ash, elm, oak etc and swamp forest with alder.

properties.kvalitet: The group of mires is variable and relatively unaffected. The area has great importance for so well the hydrological conditions as for the animal life on and around the ridge Hallandsåsen.
properties.karaktar: A large group of mires consisting of open and wooded moss-areas with well developed soaks. On some places these soaks are considerable widespread and in the north part is an old reclamation embankment probably constructed for use of fen meadows.

properties.kvalitet: Almost untouched, variable mire with rich flora. An interesting place of meeting for northern and soutwestern elements. Forest with several nationally red-listed species of cryptogams. The area contains one habitat of priority: 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Mire complex with bogs and fens, old oak forest and mixed swamp forests with pine and birch.

properties.kvalitet: The site is representative for the extensive heaths that dominated the landscape in the subatlantic parts of Scandinavia some centuries ago. The site contains one habitat type of priority: 91D0.
properties.karaktar: The site is a hilly moraine landscape dominated by open grazed heaths and occasional oak and beech forests.

properties.kvalitet: Occurrence of many nationally red-listed organisms, mostly lichens and beetles connected to old beeches and oaks. Exceptional occurrence of extremely rare organisms such as Osmoderma eremita, Enterographa hutschinsie and Leptogium cyanescens. The site contains one habitat of priority: 9080.
properties.karaktar:
Area consisting of a multitude of interesting and valuable habitats; old deciduous forests of beech and oak, extensive areas of grazed wooded pastures and large cultivated areas.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: The biological diversity is very high in the area. Numerous species of lichens have been recorded, many of them are redlisted. Also the moss flora, vascular plants, the beetle fauna etc are valuable. The site contains one habitat of priority: 9020.
properties.karaktar: Old oak-dominated forest with some beech, lime, ash and a multitude of other tree species. Some trees of the species mentioned are very thick. Lime and ash have been pollarded, a long time ago. Hazel is rather common. Well developed forest structure.

properties.kvalitet: The lake has been classified as being of great conservation interest in the county. The raised bogs is also of great interest. The lake supports a typical and rich bird fauna.
properties.karaktar: Fegen is a large oligotrophic lake with many small islands. Adjecent to the lake there are two raised bogs surrounded by broad leaved woodland.
properties.arter: Barbastell, Fiskgjuse, Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Orre, Smålom, Storlom, Sångsvan

properties.kvalitet: Old acidophilous oak forest with nationally red-listed species.
properties.karaktar:
Remnant of old acidophilous oak forest, that was characteristic for SW Sweden in ancient days.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: A high concentration of very old (several hundred years) oak trees with numerous species of nationally red-listed cryptogams and beetles. The site contains two habitats of priority: 9180 and 91E0.
properties.karaktar: A rocky area with broad-leaved forests of different types. The valley has a high concentration of old oaks (several hundred years) and thus a high biodiversity of cryptogams and beetles.

properties.kvalitet: Åstarpe mosse is a unique mosaic of different types of mires and wet heaths typical for the humid parts of southwest Scandinavia. The site contains one habitat of priority: 91D0.
properties.karaktar: A mosaic of different mire types and forests on moraine ground.

properties.kvalitet: A for the region representative and well developed inland sand dune area. The area contains one habitat type of priority: 91D0.
properties.karaktar: An inland sand dune area covered by pine trees.

properties.kvalitet: Occurrence of the extremely rare vascular plant Luronium natans. The site also hosts rare birds and a diverse fish fauna.
properties.karaktar: A rather large oligotrophic lake.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora, including som redlisted species.
properties.karaktar: Old acidophilous oak forest with several generations of multilayered oaks. Rich occurrence of dead wood. Also some beech, aspen, birches, spruce and pines. The object is situated in close connection to the river Krokån.

properties.kvalitet: Beech-forest with partially untouched character. The area contains four habitats, two of priority: 91E0 and 9080.
properties.karaktar:
Deciduous forest with a delicate position at the large lake Lyngern.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: Quite untoutched and speciesrich broadleaved decidous woodland on alkaline substrate.
properties.karaktar: Broadleaved decidous woodland on alkaline substrate.

properties.kvalitet: Important mosaic of mires and forests. The bogs are well developed. The variable landscape is important for birds and other animals.
properties.karaktar: The area is part of a larger mire complex and it is variable with bogs, fens, open water and nature forest.

properties.kvalitet: A representative area of banks in south of Kattegat. Important area of spawning and adolescence for most of the fishspecies in Kattegat. A diverse fauna of invertebrates. Especially important are the mussel beds consisting of Modiolus modiolus.
properties.karaktar: Two banks with gravel, sand, shell gravel, mussel beds and finer fractions where some fields of stones and ridges of boulderstone is spread over the banks. The biotopes are diverse and so are the fish and invertebrate fauna.

properties.kvalitet: Heathland maintained by grazing and burning. The flora contains Genista anglica, which is strongly endangered in Sweden. The site contains one habitat of priority: 6230.
properties.karaktar: The site consists of wet and dry heaths managed by burning and grazing.

properties.kvalitet: Ett vähävdat område med rödlistade arter som är hävdgynnade. Höga estetiska värden.
properties.karaktar: En mycket vacker och välhävdad björkhage. Markerna kring Abborrås är storblockiga och kraftigt kuperade, vilket i kombination av en välutvecklad grässvål ger området ett särpräglat utseende.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, many of them redlisted. Beautiful landscape.
properties.karaktar: An area of small mountains or hills with beech forests on the slopes. Central parts with very old beeches and with an untouched structure and status.

properties.kvalitet: The mire complex is situated in a for Sweden extremely western situation, and has great hydrological and plant geographical values. The site also contains untouched mixed forests and two habitats of priority: 7110 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Open complex of bogs and marshes, and untouched mixed forests.

properties.kvalitet: Very rich flora with several redlisted species.The site contains one habitat of priority: 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Mixed and coniferous forests on wet ground, with old slow-growing trees. Small streams are running through the area.

properties.kvalitet: Forests of untouched character with rich fauna and flora. The area contains nationally red-listed species and four habitats of priority: 9010, 91D0, 6230 and 9080.
properties.karaktar: Natural forests on a slope with glacifluvial and moraine formations.

properties.kvalitet: Principally untouched, variable mirecomplex. The mires are well developed and representative.
properties.karaktar: The area consists of a three mire complex. It is an illustrative gradient of how vegetation modify in relation to the distance to th sea (salt gradient).

properties.kvalitet: Området sträcker sig från Hallandsgränsen i väster till Hunnsberget och Lidhultsån i nordöst och tangerar Årshultsmyren i sydöst. Det omfattar flera vidsträckta öppna mossar  (bl.a. Lunnarna och Porsabjärsmossen), trädbevuxna mossar, långsträckta kärr och bäckar. Ute i mossarna finns fastmarksöar med huvudsakligen barrskog. På Stora Osbjär finns rester av ljunghed med bl.a. cypresslummer. Hunnsberget är ett restberg som reser sig 40 meter över omgivningen. I branterna mot sydväst växer löv-barrblandskog.
properties.karaktar: Området är en del av ett stort våtmarkskomplex och omfattar flera vidsträckta öppna mossar,  trädbevuxna mossar, långsträckta kärr och bäckar och en rest av en ljunghed. I norra kanten finns ett mycket markerat restberg, Hunnsberget, som höjer sig över de flacka omgivningarna.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient beech forest with several nationally red-listed species.
properties.karaktar: A remnant of an extensive area with ancient beech forest, now surrounded by spruce plantations.

properties.kvalitet: Parts of the beech forest is of high age with many red-listed epiphytes and documented continuity of beech forest since the 18th century.
properties.karaktar: With some exception an acidophilus beech forest, characteristic for the northern limit of the beech.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient forests with numerous red-listed species and two habitats of priority: 9080 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar:
Ancient forests in a hilly area with great views over the surroundings.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: Heaths and salt pastures of high value.
properties.karaktar: Cluster of islands dominated by heaths and salt pastures.

properties.kvalitet: Rich flora and fauna with redlisted species.
properties.karaktar: Mixed broad-leaved forest of different age with scattered old oaks, ashes and maples in a northern slope.

properties.kvalitet: A rich supply of nestholes and the fully stratified vegetation contributes to the rich bird life, which is one of the densest of breeding birds of wooded land in Sweden. The site contains 1 habitat of priority: 91E0.
properties.karaktar: A coastal area with low sand dunes and a deciduous swamp forest with alder.

properties.kvalitet: A very important site for both breeding and resting birds. Excellent salt pastures.
properties.karaktar: A coastal area with salt meadows, sand flats, sand dunes and different kinds of open grazed grassland.
properties.arter: Brushane, Ljungpipare, Myrspov, Silvertärna, Skärfläcka, Småtärna

properties.kvalitet: Well representative for bogs in western Sweden. The site contains two habitats of priority: 7110 and 91D0. The raised bog (7110) is dominant and well developed.
properties.karaktar: Mogölsmyren is a part of a vast mire-complex, Ringsmossen.

properties.kvalitet: River with genuine wild salmon stock and a variable bottom with numerous nationally red-listed species of benthic invertbrates.
properties.karaktar:
The river Fylleån flows through an area of high precipitation with mostly forests and bog land. Rapids, fast flowing water and water falls like the Danska falls and the Tolarps falls occur frequently.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: The site has its special value as a vast protected area consisting of acidophilus oak and beech forest. Of great interest is also the mire in the south, a climbing type situated in a long slope. The site contains seven habitat types of which two are of priority: 7110 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar:
The site consists of an acidophilus oak and beech forest and a large soligenous mire. The site is also of geological interest with a series of ice margin moraines in the soligenous mire.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: Beech and oak trees with a very rich epiphytic flora.
properties.karaktar: Part of a vast area of forest-mire mosaic. Western taiga character, with influence of deciduous forest.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Mindre flugsnappare, Orre, Spillkråka, Tjäder, Trana

properties.kvalitet: Ancient forests with a rich fauna and flora. Especially the epiphytic flora contains several red-listed species. The site contains two habitats of priority: 91D0 and 9010.
properties.karaktar: A hilly area with different kinds of natural forests and many red-listed species.

properties.kvalitet:
"The river: Rich invertebrate fauna. Also interesting fish and bird fauna connected to the water. 
The pasture: Occurrence of red-listed lichens on lategrown oaks."
properties.karaktar: Natural fennoscandian river Mostorpsån (Suseån) with aquatic moss vegetation and adjacent wooded pastures. The river is a natural streaming watercourse. The pasture consists of older oaks, more thin and late-grown near the river.

properties.kvalitet: Området omfattar den avsänkta Ljungsjön med omgivande våtmarker. I väster ansluter ett system av rullstensåsar där den lilla Hässjön ligger i en åsgrop. Området är ett komplex av öppna mossar sammanbundna av kärrdråg och avbrutna av talrika fastmarksholmar.
properties.karaktar: Området är en variationsrik mosaik av öppna myrar, kärrdråg, fastmarksöar och Ljungsjön. På det största sluttande mosseplanet finns ett ovanligt stort och blött höljesystem och slukhål. I väster ansluter myren till en rullstensås som delvis ligger inom området. I anslutning till åsen finns källkärr med speciell flora. Fågellivet är rikt i området.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses with several redlisted species. Rather rich occurrence of dead wood. Thew site contains one habitat of priority: 9080.
properties.karaktar: The core area consists of an old beech forest rich in epiphytes. Small stands of deciduous swamp woods and oak-hazel forest are also included in the area. Most of the area is however spruce plantations, intended to be replaced of deciduous forests.

properties.kvalitet: The area was in prehistoric time an open cultivated landscape. There are many barrows and ancient arables. In historic time the slopes have been grazed outland, that in the past, hundred years have become covered with woodland.
properties.karaktar: A both strongly hilly and flat landscape dominated by broad-leaved deciduous woodland. Moving water in the steep slopes have produced a species rich and luxuriant vegetation.

properties.kvalitet: There are many epiphytic lichens and mosses on the old beech stems. Some of these species are redlisted.
properties.karaktar:
Beech forest with trees of different ages. There are also some dead fallen trees and high stumps.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, many of them redlisted.
properties.karaktar: A cliff with west-turned slope and screes, covered with old mountain forest of oak with some beech.

properties.kvalitet: A varied area at the river Fylleån with high biodiversity and nationally red-listed species. The site contains one habitat of priority: 91E0.
properties.karaktar: An area with grazed grasslands, fens and broad-leaved forests along the river Fylleån.

properties.kvalitet: Korup är ett varierat natur- och kulturlandskap med betesmarker, gamla bokdungar, svämlövskog och kärr. Kulturlandskapet är ålderdomligt och bär många spår från äldre tider. Fäladsmarken är i stora drag opåverkad av gödsling och hyser både värdefulla vegetationstyper och typiska växter. Svämlövskogen har lång kontinuitet och är artrik. De gamla, topphuggna bokarna utgör värdefulla inslag i kulturlandskapet och den stora mängden död ved är gynnsam för många olika organismer.
properties.karaktar: Korup is a variable nature- and cultural landscape where fields and common pasture lands alternating between beech groves, alder fens and soaks. The cultivated landscape is old-fashioned with many remains of older times.

properties.kvalitet: A great and varied mire complex with natural forests. Low human impact in modern time.The site contains three habitats of priority: 7110, 91D0 and 9010.
properties.karaktar: Flatland with extensive mire complexes and low moraine hills with natural forests.
properties.arter: Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Orre, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Tjäder, Trana

properties.kvalitet: River with a genuine stock of wild salmon.
properties.karaktar: River Ätrans flows through farmlands. Areas with rapids and fast flowing waters.

properties.kvalitet: The population of Margaritifera margaritifera in Hovgårdsån is the best known in the region.
properties.karaktar: An oligotrophic small river.

properties.kvalitet: Slåtteräng med lång kontinuitet i hävden och med hotad och mycket sällsynt art.
properties.karaktar: Slåtteräng på mager mark med lång kontinuitet med trditionell hävd. Artrik vegetation med den mycket sällsynta vityxnen.

properties.kvalitet: Rich epiphytic flora with several red-listed lichens and mosses.
properties.karaktar: The main part is an old beech forest on a south-eastern hill slope.

properties.kvalitet: The forest is of high age and a certain degree of continuity is apparent, which finds expression in a rich lichen-flora on beech bark.
properties.karaktar: An acidphilus beech forest, caracteristic for the north-east limit of the beach.

properties.kvalitet: River with a genuine stock of wild salmon and freshwater pearl mussel.
properties.karaktar:
River Högvadsån flows through forests and occasional farmlands. Rapids and fast flowing waters are numerous, including the Sumpa falls.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: A varied and representative forest landscape, partly with ancient forests. The fauna and flora contains several nationally red-listed species and four habitats of priority: 7110, 91D0, 91E0 and 9080.
properties.karaktar: A rocky area with fault scarps and precipices. Beech forests with several nationally red-listed species.

properties.kvalitet: Älemossen är påverkad av det västliga läget med björkdominerade laggkärr och västlig vegetation, vilket gör denna till en ovanlig typ för regionen. Spår av tidigare torvtäckt finns. Området består också av en fäladsmark som idag betas. Djurlivet är rikt med förekomst av bl.a. rådjur, älg, räv och orre.
properties.karaktar: Ligger i ett kuperat landskap på Hallandsåsen. Gränsar till Natura 2000-området Lya Ljunghed och Älemossen. Bara en del av den 170 ha stora Älemossen ingår i Natura 2000-området. Myren är påverkad av det västliga läget med björkdominerade laggkärr och västlig vegetation, vilket gör myren till en ovanlig typ för region. Spår av tidigare torvtäckt finns.  Området består också av en fäladsmark som idag betas. Hävd förekommer dock inte på Älemossen. Djurlivet är rikt med t.ex. rådjur, älg, räv och orre.

properties.kvalitet: Salt marshes and shallow waters with a very rich bird life and nationally red-listed vascular plants. The site contains one habitat of priority: 1150.
properties.karaktar: A coastal area with salt meadows, heaths, rubble-stones and sea inlets.
properties.arter: Brushane, Fisktärna, Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Silvertärna, Skärfläcka, Småtärna

properties.kvalitet: Valuable lichen and moss flora mainly on oaks and Sambucus nigra. Also the flora of vascular plants (and presumably also the moss flora) along springs and brooks is valuable. In the county of Halland few objects of this character are to be found. The site contains one habitat of priority: 9020.
properties.karaktar: Slopes, at the river Lagan, with numerous springs and small brooks. The forest consists of a multitude of deciduous tree species (oak, aspen and ash). Hazel is common. The main feature is the occurrence of old very thick oaks, but also the interesting forest structure (different ages, multilayered) with lots of dead wood.

properties.kvalitet: One of the largest protected sand dune areas in Sweden. 13 habitats are listed among which four are of priority-type: 2130, 2140, 91E0 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: A vast area with coastal sand dunes covered by dune grasses and Pinus mugo. In the area two river mouths which frequently change position are of geomorphologic interest.

properties.kvalitet: The old beech and oak forest have a very rich flora and fauna, esp. cryptogams and insects. The area contains two habitats of priority: 9080 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar:
Ancient forests of beech and oak together with other deciduous trees and scots pine in a mountainous area rich on cliffs.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Mindre flugsnappare, Nattskärra, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka

properties.kvalitet: Old beech trees with nationally red-listed lichens.
properties.karaktar: Old beech forest of Luzulo-Fagetum type, growing on a hill ridge and slopes near a rather large oligotrophic lake.

properties.kvalitet: A forest of high age and long forest continuity, manifested in a rich epiphytic flora with many nationally red-listed species. The site contains one habitat of priority: 91E0.
properties.karaktar: Mountain covered with forests of high age and a long continuity. The geomorphology is interesting with a book ravine, which contains the richer habitats of the site.

properties.kvalitet: Natural deciduous forest with rich flora and fauna and two habitats of priority: 9180 and 91E0.
properties.karaktar: The site is a part of a greater broad-leaved forest on the northern shore of the lake Lygnern.

properties.kvalitet: A representative pasture with a rich flora.
properties.karaktar: The site is a pasture with steep sides along the water, managed by grazing and with plenty of old oaks. Parts with alluvial forest along a small stream.

properties.kvalitet: One of the oldest beech forests in this region with long continuality. It has a rich epifytflora with fetile lichens.
properties.karaktar: Beech forest.

properties.kvalitet: Coastal sand dune area with rich fauna and flora. The site contains nationally red-listed species and 12 habitat types,  of which three are of priority: 2130, 2140 and 91E0.
properties.karaktar: A sandy plain with recent sand dunes at the sea and fossil sand dunes in the eastern parts.

properties.kvalitet: The old beeches have a rich chryptogam flora with several nationally red-listed species. The area contain type locations for fungi species named by Elias Fries in the 18th century, and one habitat of priority: 9010.
properties.karaktar: A mountainous area covered with old, natural forests of beech, pine and spruce.

properties.kvalitet: Important area for breeding and stop over site for migrating birds.
properties.karaktar: Salt meadows influenced by fresh water along a small stream. The meadows are grazed by cattle.
properties.arter: Blå kärrhök, Brun kärrhök, Brushane, Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Myrspov, Skärfläcka, Smalnäbbad simsnäppa, Småtärna, Stenfalk, Sydlig kärrsnäppa

properties.kvalitet: The beech forests have a very rich epiphytic flora of lichens, mosses and fungi. Many of them are redlisted. The forests also have a rich occurrence of dead wood. The regeneration of beech is rather weak and the future is uncertain. The area contains one habitat type of priority: 9080. The swamp forest has a well developed flora of vascular plants and mosses connected to spring-swamp vegetation.
properties.karaktar: Fröllinge consists of two smaller beech stands and one deciduous swamp wood. The beech stands grow on smaller hills. The beeches are very old and the tree species has a long history in the area. The swamp wood is dominated by alder and birch. Spring vegetation can be found as well as small brooks.

properties.kvalitet: Pasture with 200-400 years old oaks hosting several nationally red-listed species of cryptogams and beetles. The site contains one habitat of priority: 9180.
properties.karaktar: A small mountain covered with pastures and, to a minor extent, broad-leaved deciduous woodland. The pastures are scattered with 200-400 years old oaks.

properties.kvalitet: In addition to the occurring annex 1 birds many nationally red-listed bird species breed in the area.
properties.karaktar: Restored wetland with a rich birdlife.

properties.kvalitet: The mixed deciduous forest of different age together with the streaming water gives a variable environment for many plant- and animal species.
properties.karaktar: Lyabäcken is a naturally torrent brook where one part is cut into a deep ravine with steep rock faces. On heights and steeps occurs a Luzulo-Fagetum beech forest with sparse vegetation. In the steeps are, however, a few small brooks and wet streams with alder, and in the bottom of the valley grows alder, ash, elm, bird cherry and hazel. Along the wet streams the forest contains trees of different age with elements of big trees, high-stumps and lying wood. Here is also a rich grove vegetation.

properties.kvalitet: A representative heath with a diverse and unique flora including redlisted species. Managed by grazing. Contains two habitats of priority: 6270 and 6230. Several endangered fungi species
properties.karaktar: The site consists of wet and dry heaths and dry to mesic grassland managed by burning and grazing. A part of an old outfield.

properties.kvalitet: Älemossen är en av få högmossar i sydvästra Sverige och Lya ljunghed är en av Skånes få bevarade större ljunghedar. Området är påverkat av bland annat dikning och torvtäkt men har stor potential och har bland annat varit föremål för restaureringsåtgärder i samband med det EU-finansierade LIFE-projektet Life to ad(d)mire.
properties.karaktar: An open Calluna-heath in a hilly moraine-landscape on the top of Hallandsås. The moraine-soils a poor in nutrients. Close to the heath-area is a mire-complex with a raised bog, partly destroyed by peat-digging and drainage, but still with natural and undisturbed parts.

properties.kvalitet: The hay meadows are of supreme interest.
properties.karaktar: The site constitutes the old agricultural landscape of a small forest farm, with meadows and surrounding grazing pastures.

properties.kvalitet: The meadow has a rich flora and is managed by hay mowing followed by grazing every year.
properties.karaktar: A hilly and stony haymaking pasture.

properties.kvalitet: The bog complex is distinctly eccentric with marked strains in parallel, concentric patterns. The area has a rich birdlife and contains two habitats of priority: 7110 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Part of an extensive bog near the river Nissan.

properties.kvalitet: Largely unexploited coastal area with wonderful beaches, sanddunes, salt pastures, mesophile grasslands, large areas of shingle and rough, rocky areas. The southern parts are rather flat, whereas the rocky areas at Hovs hallar in the north offer an excellent view of the sea. The reserve is dominated by large areas of grassland that has been used by grazing cattle and sheep for centuries. The long tradition of grazing has resulted in a rich and varied flora, including a large number of rare and threatened plants. The reserve holds the total swedish population of Scutellaria minor, as well as the largest population of Luronium natans in Sweden.
properties.karaktar: The bedrock is precambrian; gneisses in the south and sandstone to the north. Coastal, almost Atlantic, heaths with a large number of small fens and streams, interrupted by large areas of shingle and rocky areas. Extensive grazing during at least 1000 years has created an open landscape with species-rich grasslands.

properties.kvalitet: Beech trees with numerous species of nationally red-listed lichens, mosses and beetles. The beetles are connected to old and hollow trunks.
properties.karaktar: Beech forests of different ages growing on hills and slopes near a large oligotophic lake. Old and rather wellgrown beeches dominat the beech forests.

properties.kvalitet: Ancient oak forest containing one habitat of priority: 91D0.
properties.karaktar: A rest of old acidophilus oak forest characteristic for SW Sweden in ancient days.

properties.kvalitet: The epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses is very rich, and several nationally redlisted species are connected to the slow-grown beeches. On the steep sides there are redlisted epilithic mosses.
properties.karaktar: Beech forests of different ages on hills and slopes. Many beeches are very old. On the hills where the soil layer is thin, slow-grown trees are common.

properties.kvalitet: A representative old agricultural landscape with a typical flora of vascular plants.
properties.karaktar: A small forest farm with an old agricultural landscape. Small areas of meadow are managed in traditional way by hay cutting every year.

properties.kvalitet: A representative coastal area with grazed heaths and meadows. The site contains one habitat of priority: 6230.
properties.karaktar: A coastal, rocky heath landscape with salt marshes at the coastline.

properties.kvalitet: An area with representative broad-leaved forests and rocky slopes with a rich flora (red-listed species). The site contains two habitats of priority: 6230 and 9180.
properties.karaktar: Virsehatt has a dramatic topography with a dome shaped mountain raising 70 m above the surrounding area. Grassland, a wet area with birch and alder trees and a brook with fast flowing water surround the oak and beech covered mountain. Besides the biological values, the site is of geological and recreational interest.

properties.kvalitet: Området har stora naturvärden med olikåldrig bokskog med intressant kryptogamflora.
properties.karaktar: Omfattande ädellövskogsområde innehållande flera olika skogstyper, ekskog, krattekskog, bokskog samt blandskog med barrträd och asp.

properties.kvalitet: Occurrence of Triturus cristatus. For the region unusually rich herb flora.
properties.karaktar: The area contains a natural deciduous forest with several tree species and wooded as well as open pastures.

properties.kvalitet: Unusual habitat including several unusual species for instance Osmunda regalis.
properties.karaktar: Water course which splits in to several channels fringed by broad leaved deciduous woodland subject to regular flooding.

properties.kvalitet: Representative heath-landscape partially managed by advanced heath-cultivation. The site contains two habitats of priority: 6230, 7110.
properties.karaktar: A landscape on rocky hills with heathlands, oak forests and coniferous forests. Most of the forest is the first generation after heath.

properties.kvalitet: All meadows are managed by hay cutting every year. The flora of vascular plants is rich and there are also some redlisted lichens on the pollarded stems. It is a representative old agricultural farm.
properties.karaktar: The site constitutes the old agricultural landscape of a small forest farm, with meadows, pollarded trees and surrounding grazing pastures.

properties.kvalitet: A representative area of shallow banks in middle of Kattegatt.  Important area of spawning and adolescence for most of the fishspecies in Kattegatt. A diverse flora of makroalgae.
properties.karaktar: Shallow bank with sand and finer fractions where fields of stones and boulderstones and ridges of boulderstone is spread over the bank. The biotopes are diverse and so are the flora of luxuriant makroalgae.

properties.kvalitet: Important area for breeding and stop over site for migrating birds. The area is part of a larger RAMSAR site.
properties.karaktar: Grazed coastal meadows with rich occurence of waders.
properties.arter: Blå kärrhök, Brun kärrhök, Brushane, Fisktärna, Grönbena, Kentsk tärna, Ljungpipare, Myrspov, Silvertärna, Skärfläcka, Smalnäbbad simsnäppa, Småtärna, Stenfalk

properties.kvalitet: Område med lång hävdkontinuitet och med förekomst av Vertigo angustior och V. geyeri. Rikkärret har mycket värdefull flora. Tyvärr har en del av området runt omkring kärret dikats ut, och bäcken har rätats ut, vilket har påverkat kärret.
properties.karaktar: Flack, tämligen näringsrik, slåtterhävded kalkfuktäng (avstängslad från omgivande betesmark). Rätt högvuxen vegetation med insprängda partier med lägre vegetation.

properties.kvalitet: In the major forest types over 50 redlisted species have been found of many different organisms . Most important groups are macrofungi, lichens, vascular plants, land molluscs and mosses. The area is the most important for these forest types and organisms in th region.
properties.karaktar: Nemoral forest on nutrient.rich soils on northern hill slopes. Major forest types are meadow beech forests, alder-ash forests and eutrophic elm-ash forests. Mineralrich springs and small brooks constitutes important habitats as well.

properties.kvalitet: Well developed marshes. One of the larger solid islets with nature forest with rather rich occurrence of dead wood.
properties.karaktar: The area is part of a larger mire complex and consists of open fens, heath (covered with bushes) and nature forest.

properties.kvalitet: A representative part of the old coastal heath-landscape. The area contains nine habitat types, of which one is of priority: 6230.
properties.karaktar: A representative part of the coast of northern Halland. Mountainous and cliffy at the shore, but sandy in the inner parts.

properties.kvalitet: Valuable beech forests rich of dead wood. Interesting epiphytic flora of lichens and mosses, many of them redlisted.
properties.karaktar: Rift valley covered by deciduous forests of untouched character. Mostly beech forests of high age. The creek is a natural meandering watercourse surounded by wetlands of open fens which are flooded every spring and autumn. In the western part a variable mire with fens and small dystrophic lakes.

properties.kvalitet: Containing rich and variable, representative mire-complexes. Rich flora with threatened heath species and birds belonging to large open mires. The site contains four habitats of priority: 7110, 91D0, 9010 and 6230.
properties.karaktar: Situated in the most humid area of south Sweden. Vast raised bogs are found together with sloping bogs and fens. At Asperammsmossen extensive wet and dry heaths are in a very good status (burned every year). Smaller parts of nature forests.
properties.arter: Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Nattskärra, Sparvuggla, Storlom, Tjäder, Trana, Törnskata

properties.kvalitet: Old acidophilous oak forest with nationally red-listed lichens.
properties.karaktar: Remnant of old acidophilous oak forest, that was characteristic for SW Sweden in ancient days. The site also contains a minor rift valley with vertical cliffs.

properties.kvalitet: A vast mire complex with low human influence since many decades. The site contains three habitats of priority: 7110, 9010 and 91D0.
properties.karaktar: Vast mire complex consisting of bogs, fens and swamp forests.
properties.arter: Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Orre, Spillkråka, Tjäder, Trana

properties.kvalitet: Practically untouched hydrology. Large areas of connected wet heaths.
properties.karaktar: Variable wetland complex with wet heaths and meadows, bogs and fens. Through the area there is a small stream running with very rich flora alongside.

properties.kvalitet: In the major forest types 15 red listed species have been found of different organisms groups such as insects, birds, macro fungi, lichens and mosses. The area is important for these forest types and organisms in the region.
properties.karaktar: Nemoral forest on nutrient rich soils in northern hill slopes. Major forest types are beach forest of tall herb type and of low herb type, open pasture and grazed wooded pastures with old trees of oak, alder ash forests and eutrophic elm-ash forests. Mineral rich springs and small brooks constitute important habitats as well.

properties.kvalitet: A representative river valley with oak-forests and grazed areas. Rich fauna and flora with red-listed species. The site contains two habitata of priority: 6230 and 9080.
properties.karaktar: An area with open grazed grassland, broad-leaved forests and a river with waterfalls and rapids.

properties.kvalitet: A unique coastal area with lagoons and grazed meadows. The birdlife is very rich with planty of nationally red-listed species. Contains one habitat of priority: 1150.
properties.karaktar: A coastal area with sea inlets, estuaries and salt marshes.
properties.arter: Blå kärrhök, Brun kärrhök, Brushane, Dubbelbeckasin, Fiskgjuse, Fisktärna, Grönbena, Ljungpipare, Mindre sångsvan, Myrspov, Salskrake, Skärfläcka, Smalnäbbad simsnäppa, Småfläckig sumphöna, Småtärna, Stenfalk, Svarttärna, Sydlig kärrsnäppa, Sångsvan, Trana, Vitkindad gås
